newsitem.title: USA: PHP to buy New Jersey health plan assets. [CORRECTED 20:31 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PHP to buy New Jersey health plan assets. [CORRECTED 20:31 GMT]

text.p: PHP Healthcare Corp. will buy some assets of the non-profit HIP Health Plan of New Jersey (corrects to add "some assets of") in a $73 million deal that will double PHP's annual revenues, the companies said Thursday.
The deal is part of a 20-year agreement that includes a strategic alliance, they said.
PHP will take over 18 health care centres and pharmacy and optical and other ancillary services, with 200,000 members, and manage them under its Pinnacle Health Enterprises unit.
HIP will continue to set the quality standards and monitor patient care as well as remain responsible for the development of new health care programmes and new member recruitment, they said.
PHP, based in Reston, Va., manages more than 90 health care projects in 28 markets.
HIP Health Plan of New Jersey is part of the HIP system with affiliates in New York, Pennsylvania, and Florida.
PHP's stock rose $1.06 to $17.875 in consolidated trading on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
